defects.title: reaction nodes are removed from RBG with their node indices in dBTM
defects.trigger: dBTM whose first node is a conserved bond with no edge (node order: conserved A bond, reacting A bond, reaction R1, reacting B bond), model.rxns = {'R1'}
defects.observed: MATLAB R2025a: RAG holds atoms 1-2 only, CAG atoms 3-6; line 105 rmnode(RBG, reactionNodes) uses dBTM indices (line 63), which in RBG point to the B bond
defects.expected: RAG atoms 1-4 (all reacting bonds), CAG atoms 5-6, as with the conserved node listed last

notes: Reproduction (MATLAB R2025a): nodes = table({'A';'A';'R1';'B'}, (1:4)', [5;1;0;3], [6;2;0;4], 'VariableNames', {'mets','BondIndex','BondHeadAtomIndex','BondTailAtomIndex'}); edges = table([2 3; 3 4], {'A';'R1'}, {'R1';'B'}, 'VariableNames', {'EndNodes','HeadMet','TailMet'}); dBTM = digraph(edges, nodes); dATM = digraph(table([1 3; 2 4], 'VariableNames', {'EndNodes'}), table((1:6)', {'A';'A';'B';'B';'A';'A'}, 'VariableNames', {'AtomIndex','mets'})); m.rxns = {'R1'}; [~,~,CAG,RAG] = identifyConservedReactingSubgraphs(m, dATM, dBTM); RAG.Nodes.AtomIndex is [1;2], CAG.Nodes.AtomIndex is [3;4;5;6]. With the conserved component listed last (reacting nodes 1-3) the result is right (RAG 1-4), and when the dBTM index exceeds numnodes(RBG) rmnode silently removes nothing, so the reaction node stays in RBSG. testConservedReactingMoieties.m calls the function in a multi-function workflow test (not a test of this function only), so a new file was written. Callers that reach it: that workflow (identifyConservedReactingMoieties tutorial path) - lead to check the quarantine ledger.
confirmed_by: lead (writer's MATLAB reproduction: rmnode on RBG uses dBTM node indices, so the reacting atom graph is wrong when a conserved bond comes first)

defects.title: without CellNetAnalyzer a call with an output stops with an unassigned-output error
defects.trigger: cnaModel = convertCbModelToCNAModel(model) when startcna is not on the path
defects.observed: MATLAB R2025a: 'Output argument "cnaModel" (and possibly others) not assigned a value ...' after the checkCNAinstallation message
defects.expected: an error saying CellNetAnalyzer is needed

notes: CellNetAnalyzer stand-ins (startcna, CNAgenerateMFNetwork) are written to a tempname folder; the real external CNAcobra2cna (external/analysis/CnaCobraInterface) does the conversion; the path is saved and restored. Severity decision for the lead: the sibling convertCNAModelToCbModel entry (feature 20261104) records the same unassigned-output behaviour as 'error'; here it is 'cosmetic' because the call cannot succeed without CellNetAnalyzer and only the message is unhelpful. Callee defect (external, not src): CNAcobra2cna line 37 loops i = 1:size(cnap.specLongName, 2) (characters) over rows, so any model whose longest metabolite name is longer than the number of metabolites stops with 'Index in position 1 exceeds array bounds' (e.g. 2 metabolites named 'met a','b'); the test uses one-character names. testConvertCNAModelToCbModel.m calls this function only in its never-run CellNetAnalyzer branch, so a new file was written.

Expected values read off the hand-built dictionary. testFastGapFill.m calls the function in a workflow (not a test of this function only). Run-time call depending on arguments: mapMetName2KEGGID (only with the dictionary input).

New folder test/verifiedTests/base/testNewt (no test of src/base/io/newt existed). Line 149 exempt: dead code, useM is the constant 0 (line 146). convertSBMLID is called on every input but its result is unused. Possibly worth a look (not recorded as a defect): the default zeroColor equals minColor (#FF0000) while the code comment shows #FFFFFF for zero.
